WITH group_avgs AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(CAST(articount AS REAL)) as group_avg
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE articount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY equipref
),
overall_avg_1 AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM group_avgs
),
filtered_groups AS (
  SELECT g.equipref, g.group_avg
  FROM group_avgs g, overall_avg_1 o
  WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND g.group_avg > o.overall_avg
),
overall_avg_2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_avg) as final_avg
  FROM filtered_groups
)
SELECT 
  f.equipref,
  f.group_avg,
  f.group_avg - o.overall_avg as diff,
  CASE WHEN f2.final_avg IS NOT NULL AND f2.final_avg != 0
    THEN f.group_avg / f2.final_avg
    ELSE NULL
  END as division
FROM filtered_groups f
CROSS JOIN overall_avg_1 o
CROSS JOIN overall_avg_2 f2
WHERE f2.final_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY division IS NULL, division DESC
LIMIT 10
